name: reindex
description: Index workspace for all malong analysis tools. MUST call first for new workspaces. blocking=true waits. Responses include done:true|false.

workspace_dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory. Omit this to check current indexing status / progress.

blocking.description: If true, wait for indexing to complete before returning (default false = async).

maxFiles.description: Max files to index (default 5000, 0=unlimited). Increase if project has many files.

skipDirs.description: Skip specific directories by relative path, e.g. ["runtime1", "0通天/eval-cases"]. Useful when pre-check says too many files.

ignoreDirs.description: Additional directory names to skip globally (e.g. ["deps", "archive"]). Combined with built-in defaults.

threshold.description: File count threshold for pre-check review (default 2000). Set higher to skip pre-check.
